title: Arawakan languages - Wikipedia
text: Arawakan, also known as Maipurean (also Maipuran), is a language family spoken amongst various Indigenous peoples in South America. Branches migrated to Central America and the Greater Antilles and Lesser Antilles in the Caribbean and the Atlantic, including what is now the Bahamas. title: Ta-Arawakan languages - Wikipedia
text: The Ta-Arawakan languages, also known as Ta-Maipurean and Caribbean, are the Indigenous Arawakan languages of the Caribbean islands and mostly coastal South America. They are distinguished by the first person pronominal prefix ta-, as opposed to common Arawakan na-.
